## 🧲 AI Lead Qualifier
Web form / email lead → normalize → **LLM score (JSON-schema validated, 1 retry, fallback)** → CRM upsert (dedup by email) → hot lead alerts.

Config via env: `CRM_TARGET` = hubspot | airtable | sheets. Failures → *Lead Qualifier – Error Alerts* workflow.

### 🤖 AI qualification
OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`LLM_BASE_URL`) — OpenAI, Claude, Bedrock, or the offline mock. `max_tokens` capped, cost per lead tracked.

### 🗂 CRM upsert (one record per email)
HubSpot batch upsert · Airtable performUpsert · Google Sheets (Apps Script)

### 🔔 Hot lead alerts (score ≥ 70)
Telegram + email with reason & suggested reply
